en: Multi-view color postcard labeled TULCEA, showing modernist cityscapes: a pedestrian promenade with apartment blocks, a civic building with a sweeping curved roof, a large socialist-era administrative building with a coat of arms, a high-rise hotel, and the Danube waterfront with boats and the port. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp, and address lines.
